purpose: Numerical qualification of real-encoder and native joint-predictor affine constraints; not a GRASP run, Clean task test, attack or defense experiment.
prior_inspection_disclosure: Before this protocol, the root agent performed one read-only checkpoint deserialization to inspect keys and shapes. No model inference from that inspection is claimed. This protocol is frozen before this probe's inference outputs.

model_loading.encoder: Existing helper.DINO_WEIGHTS and helper.DINO_SOURCE local paths
model_loading.method: Patch helper.MODEL to wall.MODEL and call helper.load_model(wall.cfg_for(helper, output, 'cpu'), 'cpu'); strict state_dict loads; no optional decoders.
model_loading.precision: Native FP32 model and tensors; FP64 affine-constraint construction and residual arithmetic.
model_loading.network: Forbidden; missing local assets fail closed.
model_loading.rendering: Do not call helper.bootstrap, import environment/rendering entrypoints, construct/reset an environment, or render images.

unroll.action_semantics: Fixed normalized model-action coordinates; no claim of physical execution or replay.
unroll.context: Only the encoded initial observation, expanded by the native wrapper to two candidates.

affine_constraints.encoder: Left null vector of diag(gamma_encoder) @ (I - 11^T/384); offset beta_encoder. Extend its normal with 16 zero proprio coordinates.
affine_constraints.predictor: Left null vector of blockdiag(W_visual, I16) @ diag(gamma_predictor) @ (I - 11^T/400); offset concat(W_visual @ beta_visual + bias_visual, beta_proprio).
affine_constraints.normal_construction: FP64 full SVD, last left singular vector, normalize to Euclidean norm one, deterministic sign by largest-magnitude coordinate.
affine_constraints.residual: For every individual patch: r_encoder=n_encoder dot (visual-beta_encoder); r_predictor=n_predictor dot (concat(visual,proprio)-predictor_offset).
affine_constraints.union_distance: min(abs(r_encoder), abs(r_predictor)) per patch, without temporal or patch averaging.
affine_constraints.normalization_warning: Learned LayerNorm scales/biases and predictor projection are included. If normalize_reps is true, reject this derivation rather than silently apply it after an additional normalization.
affine_constraints.scope_warning: The union covers real encoded joint frames and complete native joint forecast frames. It does not assert a visual-only predictor hyperplane or preserve a hybrid combining predicted visual features with unrelated/current true proprio.

virtual_control.generator: One independent torch CPU generator advanced in root order 1,2,3
virtual_control.operation: Add independent FP32 Gaussian noise to each visual coordinate; leave proprio unchanged.
virtual_control.interpretation: Synthetic residual-only separation control, not an actual GRASP query or attack.

native_style_hybrid_control.label: native_style_hybrid_not_actual_GRASP_execution
native_style_hybrid_control.source: All three successor visual frames of both native rollout candidates, excluding the initial prefix
native_style_hybrid_control.operation: Keep each native successor visual unchanged and replace its paired predicted proprio by the encoded initial proprio expanded across time and candidate batch, preserving patch order.
native_style_hybrid_control.interpretation: Synthetic reconstruction of the current-proprio pairing found in the published adapter, not an executed GRASP query. It distinguishes Gaussian displacement from a mismatch introduced by combining otherwise native components.

qualification_gate.synthetic_consumer_signal: At least one patch in either the Gaussian virtual control or the native-style hybrid control has union distance strictly greater than 1e-5 across the fixed panel. Report both controls separately, including every root and the fraction above tolerance; do not claim Gaussian noise is the sole source of departure.
qualification_gate.interpretation: Passing only establishes sampled numerical coverage of complete paired joint encoder/rollout outputs and sensitivity to at least one synthetic consumer construction. It does not prove coverage for every possible input or caller, native planner competence, harm, or novelty.
qualification_gate.failure_rule: Preserve failed/partial outputs; no retry, threshold increase, root replacement, noise tuning, or new model calls in this registration.
